ui-polish-review.title: Polish: design vs. impl review report
ui-polish-review.description: Compare captures against D1 visual spec, Track A UX spec, motion spec, and contrast matrix. Severity-ranked report with exact pixel/spacing/color/typography deltas. Stage 2 of 2.
acceptCriteria: Every capture cross-referenced against design spec with PASS/POLISH/ISSUE verdict
Report severity-buckets: Issue (visible drift) / Polish (subtle) / Pass
Each finding cites design spec line number + code file/line where applicable
Concrete fix suggestions for each non-PASS finding
